info.title: Karigar Service Marketplace API
info.description: RESTful API for Karigar - A service marketplace connecting customers with skilled service providers (electricians, plumbers, carpenters, etc.)

post.description: Register a new customer or service provider
Authenticate user and return JWT token
Get a new JWT token using existing valid token
Invalidate JWT token and logout user

get.description: Get dashboard stats based on user role (admin: platform stats, provider: earnings/requests, customer: bookings)
Retrieve paginated list of notifications for authenticated user
Get count of unread notifications for authenticated user
Get a single notification (automatically marks as read)

post.description: Mark specific notifications as read by their IDs
Mark all unread notifications as read for authenticated user

get.description: Retrieve current authenticated user's profile information

post.description: Update user's personal profile details (name, email, phone, etc.)
Upload or update user's profile picture (JPEG, PNG, GIF - max 5MB)

picture.description: Profile picture file (JPEG, PNG, GIF - max 5MB)

422.description: Invalid file or file too large

post.description: Change the current user's password with verification of existing password

new_password.description: New password (min 8 chars, must differ from current)

message.example: Please login again with your new password

422.description: Validation error - password too weak or does not match confirmation

get.description: Retrieve list of service providers with optional filters (category, location, search)
Get detailed information about a specific service provider including services and reviews
Service provider can view their own profile and services

403.description: Access denied - not a service provider

put.description: Service provider can update their profile information

get.description: Retrieve service requests filtered by user role. Customers see their requests, providers see requests for them.

post.description: Customer creates a booking request for a service provider

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific service request

put.description: Service provider accepts a requested booking
Service provider rejects a requested booking
Service provider reschedules a booking to a new date/time
Service provider marks a confirmed request as completed
Customer or provider can cancel a requested/confirmed booking

post.description: Customer submits a review and rating for a completed service

400.description: Validation error or review already exists

get.description: Get all reviews and ratings for a specific service provider
List all roles with their associated permissions

post.description: Admin creates a new role with optional permissions

get.description: Admin can view all users with optional filters
Admin can view detailed information about a specific user

put.description: Admin approves a service provider profile

bearerAuth.description: Enter JWT token in format: Bearer {token}
